title: BRAKE LEVER ADJUSTING DEVICE
abstract: A brake lever adjusting device comprises of, a hollow cuboidal body 101 positioned on a front brake lever of a two-wheeler vehicle, a pair of L-shaped rods 102, each equipped with a suction cups 103 for adhering, an imaging unit 104 integrated with a for capturing multiple images of brake lever, a vertical telescopically operated pole 107 integrated for tightly gripping brake lever, a motorized ball and socket joint 110 installed in between pole 107 and body 101 to provide movement to clipper 109, and a two axis lead screw arrangement 112 installed in between ceiling portion of body 101 to provide translation to unit for adjusting spacing in between accelerator and brake lever.
specification:
FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001]	The present invention relates to a brake lever adjusting device that securely attaches to the vehicle, ensuring stability during operation, which helps to maintain a proper functionality by preventing unwanted movement or misalignment, allowing the device to perform its intended tasks accurately and efficiently without external disruptions, ensuring reliable and consistent performance under various conditions.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
	
[0002]	 The process of controlling and maintaining the functionality of brake levers in two-wheeler vehicles is essential for the safety and performance of the vehicle. Over time, there have been advancements in technology to assist in improving the interaction with brake systems and other controls in vehicles. Proper alignment and consistent operation of the brake lever are critical for the safe and efficient performance of the vehicle.

[0003]	 Traditionally, ensuring the correct positioning and alignment of the brake lever and other controls required manual inspection and adjustment by technicians. This process involved the use of simple tools like gauges and manual measuring devices to check the distance between the brake lever and other components like the accelerator. These adjustments were time-consuming and required a skilled technician to ensure that the brake lever was in proper working condition. Additionally, manual adjustment could sometimes result in imprecise alignment, leading to inefficiency in brake operation.

[0004]	JP2000095173A a brake lever is mounted on a right handle pipe, to which a right handle grip is mounted, in a manner that it can move circularly either forward or backward. When the brake lever moves circularly either forward or backward, a hydraulic pressure is generated in a brake master cylinder. The brake master cylinder is provided so that it projects forward with respect to the handle pipe. An adjusting shaft, which adjusts play in the brake lever, projects further forward from its end and this adjusting shaft is remotely controlled by a remote control knob via a flexible cable. The flexible cable is installed transversely across and in front of a right and left front forks to allow the remote control knob 40 to be positioned near a left handle grip.

[0005]	CN107521606B relates to a brake control device. The hydraulic brake control device is for attachment to an open-ended handlebar of a vehicle, the handlebar having a longitudinal axis. A brake housing is attachable to the handle, the brake housing including a first portion located outside of the handle and abutting an open end of the handle and a second portion sized and shaped to be received within the handle. A master cylinder is disposed within the first portion and has a master cylinder chamber with a bore axis oriented transverse to the axis of the handle, and a master cylinder actuator is operatively associated with the master cylinder. Also provided with a fine adjustment mechanism, a coarse adjustment mechanism and a clamping mechanism. And also relates to a hydraulic brake control device for controlling braking of a vehicle and a clamping mechanism.
	
[0006]	Conventionally, many devices are disclosed in prior art that are capable providing assistance in brake lever adjustment, but these devices lack in monitoring the position and movement of the brake lever to allow precise adjustments, ensuring accurate alignment and proper functionality.

[0007]	In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that requires to be capable of providing assistance in brake lever adjustment. In addition, the device also needs to be capable of controlling the force applied to the brake lever to ensure smooth operation without causing mechanical strain or compromising braking efficiency.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0008]	 The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0009]	 An object of the present invention is to develop a device that ensures secure and stable attachment to the vehicle to maintain proper functionality during operation, which helps to maintain a proper functionality by preventing unwanted movement or misalignment.

[0010]	Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that accurately detects the position and movement of the brake lever to enable precise adjustments to enable accurate adjustments and ensure proper alignment and functionality.

[0011]	 Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that regulate the force applied to the brake lever to ensure efficient operation without causing mechanical strain or ineffective braking.
    	
[0012]	 The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0013]	 The present invention relates to a brake lever adjusting device that accurately detects the position and movement of the brake lever to enable accurate adjustments and ensure proper alignment and functionality, which helps in optimizing performance, preventing errors, and enhancing overall efficiency.

[0014]	 According to an embodiment of the present invention, a brake lever adjusting device comprises of a hollow cuboidal body positioned on a front brake lever of a two-wheeler vehicle, a pair of L-shaped rods, each equipped with a suction cups for adhering the rods over dashboard of the vehicle, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit integrated with a processor in synchronization with an ultrasonic sensor positioned within the body for capturing multiple images of the brake lever, a cylindrical unit mounted on a ceiling portion of the body and installed with an extendable link to extend and position the cylindrical unit in between the brake lever and accelerator of the two-wheeler vehicle, a vertical telescopically operated pole integrated with multiple hinges attached on the body to extend and position a clipper attached with the pole in proximity to the brake lever for tightly gripping the brake lever, a motorized ball and socket joint installed in between the pole and the body to provide movement to the clipper for pulling the lever, an expandable pulley arrangement integrated in the cylindrical unit for pulling the lever inwards, a two axis lead screw arrangement installed in between the ceiling portion of the body and the link to provide translation to the unit for adjusting spacing in between the accelerator and the brake lever.

[0015]	According to another embodiment of the present invention, the proposed device further comprises of a pressure sensor installed on the clipper for detecting applied pressure over the lever, an electronically controlled nozzle attached with a storage chamber installed to dispense the oil over the lever in view of providing lubrication to the lever, a corrosion sensor installed within the body for detecting presence of corrosion over the lever, a speaker mounted on the body to notify the user for treating the detected corrosion, a pneumatic unit that includes an air compressor, air cylinder, air valves and piston which works in collaboration to aid in extension and retraction of the link and pole, and a battery is associated with the device for supplying power to electrical and electronically operated components associated with the device.

[0016]	 While the invention has been described and shown with particular reference to the preferred embodiment, it will be apparent that variations might be possible that would fall within the scope of the present invention.

[0021]	The present invention relates to a brake lever adjusting device that regulates the force applied to the brake lever and ensures efficient operation without causing mechanical strain in order to prevent excessive wear, and maintains consistent braking performance.

[0022]	Referring to Figure 1, an isometric view of a brake lever adjusting device is illustrated, comprising a hollow cuboidal body 101 positioned on a front brake lever of a two-wheeler vehicle, a pair of L-shaped rods 102, each equipped with a suction cups 103, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 104 mounted on the body 101, a cylindrical unit 105 mounted on a ceiling portion of the body 101 and installed with an extendable link 106, a vertical telescopically operated pole 107 integrated with multiple hinges 108 attached on the body 101, a clipper 109 attached with the pole 107 in proximity to the brake lever, motorized ball and socket joint 110 installed in between the pole 107 and the body 101, an expandable pulley 111 arrangement integrated in the cylindrical unit 105, a two axis lead screw arrangement 112 installed in between the ceiling portion of the body 101 and the link 106, an electronically controlled nozzle 113 attached with a storage chamber 114 installed within the body 101 stored with lubrication oil and a speaker 115 mounted on the body 101.

[0023]	The proposed device herein comprises of a hollow cuboidal body 101 that is positioned on the front brake lever of a two-wheeler vehicle to provide stability. The body 101 is equipped with a pair of L-shaped rods 102, each featuring suction cups 103 at the ends of the suction cups 103. These suction cups 103 adhere firmly to the vehicle's dashboard, ensuring a secure attachment. 

[0024]	To activate the device, the user manually presses a push button which is installed on the body 101. Upon pressing the button, the circuits within the device gets close, allowing electric current to flow. The push button has an outer casing and an inner mechanism, including a spring and metal contacts. When the button is pressed, the spring-loaded mechanism inside is pushes down on. In the default state, the internal contacts are apart, so the circuit is open and no electricity flows. Pressing the button makes the contacts touch each other, closing the circuit and allowing electricity to flow, which activates an inbuilt microcontroller that regulates the further options of the device.

[0025]	The microcontroller then activates an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 104 integrated with a processor inside the body 101 to capture multiple images of the brake lever. The imaging unit 104 comprises of an image capturing arrangement 112 including a set of lenses that captures multiple images in vicinity of the break lever, and the captured images are stored within a memory of the imaging unit 104 in form of an optical data. The imaging unit 104 also comprises of the processor that is encrypted with artificial intelligence protocols, such that the processor processes the optical data and extracts the required data from the captured images. The extracted data is further converted into digital pulses and bits and are further transmitted to the microcontroller. 

[0026]	An ultrasonic sensor positioned within the body 101 is activated by the microcontroller to work in synchronization with the imaging unit 104 to determine the alignment of the brake lever. The ultrasonic sensor operates by emitting high-frequency sound waves from a transducer which travels through the air to hit the brake lever and reflects to the sensor. The sensor measures the time taken by the sound waves to return after bouncing off. The time delay is used to determine the alignment of the brake lever.

[0027]	Based detected alignment of the brake lever, an extendable link 106 mounted on the ceiling portion of the body 101 is actuated by the microcontroller to extend and position a cylindrical unit 105 attached on the distal end of the link 106 between the brake lever and the accelerator of the two-wheeler vehicle. The extendable link 106 operates through a pneumatic unit comprising an air compressor, air cylinder, air valves, and a piston, working together to extend and retract the link 106. The link 106 features a nested tube arrangement, with multiple concentric hollow tubes. The air cylinder, attached at the bottom of the nested tubes, houses a piston at the top. The air cylinder has an inlet and outlet valve connected to the compressor, which compresses air drawn from the surroundings. The pressurized air from the compressor enters the inlet valve, driving the piston forward. As the piston moves, the nested tubes are sequentially extended, lengthening the link 106.

[0028]	Upon positioning the unit between the brake lever and the accelerator, a vertical telescopically operated pole 107 integrated with multiple hinges 108 and attached to the body 101 is actuated by the microcontroller to extend and position a clipper 109 attached to the pole 107 near the brake lever. The pole 107 herein extends through the pneumatic arrangement as mentioned above. The clipper 109 securely grips the brake lever, ensuring stability and proper alignment. The clipper 109 works by using an electric motor connected to a sliding jaw via a screw. The motor provides power to the screw that is attached to the fixed frame of the clipper 109. As the screw rotates, it pushes or pulls the sliding jaw towards or away from the fixed jaw depending on the direction of rotation. This movement allows the clipper 109 to grip the brake lever.

[0029]	After gripping the brake lever, a motorized ball and socket joint 110 installed between the telescopically operated pole 107 and the body 101 is actuated by the microcontroller to provide movement to the clipper 109 in order to effectively pull the brake lever inward. The motorized ball and socket joint 110 allows for smooth, adjustable movement of the rod 102 in various directions. The joint herein, has a ball-shaped part that fits into a cup-like socket. A motor controls this ball, making the ball to move around inside the socket. Actuators adjust the ball’s position to ensure that the ball moves accurately and flexibly, enabling accurate and controlled positioning of the rod 102 in multiple directions.

[0030]	In synchronization with the ball and socket joint 110, an expandable pulley 111 arrangement 112 integrated into the cylindrical unit 105 is actuated by the microcontroller to modify the diameter of the cylindrical unit 105 as needed for pulling the brake lever inward. This arrangement 112 adjusts dynamically based on the required force, ensuring efficient and controlled movement of the lever. The expandable pulley 111 allows the cylindrical unit 105 to change its diameter without any physical effort. The expandable pulley 111 arrangement 112 consists of two main components: an outer pulley 111 shell and an inner core. The inner core is mounted on a shaft and is capable of moving axially within the outer shell. By changing the position of the inner core relative to the outer shell, the effective diameter of the cylindrical unit 105 is increased/decreased. When the core moves towards the center of the shell, the cylindrical unit 105 is retracted and when the core moves away the diameter increases.

[0031]	A pressure sensor is installed on the clipper 109 to detect the applied pressure on the brake lever. The pressure sensor used here is a capacitive pressure sensor that works by measuring changes in capacitance. It consists of two conductive plates separated by a small gap. When pressure is applied, the gap between these plates changes, altering the capacitance. The sensor detects this change and converts it into an electrical signal that relates to the amount of pressure. The signal is then transmitted to the microcontroller, where it is processed to provide an accurate pressure reading.

[0032]	Based on the detected pressure applied by the clipper 109, the microcontroller adjusts the expandable pulley 111 arrangement 112 within the cylindrical unit 105 to modify the diameter. This ensures that the optimum amount of force is applied to the brake lever, preventing excessive pressure that could cause mechanical strain or insufficient pressure that may lead to ineffective braking.

[0033]	As the cylindrical unit 105 is expended, a two-axis lead screw arrangement 112 is installed between the ceiling portion of the body 101 and the extendable link 106 is actuated by the microcontroller to adjust the spacing between the accelerator and brake lever by moving the cylindrical unit 105 accordingly. The two-axis lead screw arrangement 112 provides movement by using two lead screws, each aligned along a different axis. Each lead screw is driven by its motor, which rotates in their respective lead screws, which have a threaded shaft that interacts with a nut mounted on the lead screw connected to the cylindrical unit 105. When a motor turns its lead screw, the nut moves linearly along the screw's length leading to the movement of the cutting unit. The cutting unit moves on the X and Y axes in a synchronized manner to position the cylindrical unit 105.

[0034]	Alongside the pulling of the brake lever, an electronically controlled nozzle 113 attached to a storage chamber 114 which holds lubrication oil is actuated by the microcontroller to dispense oil onto the brake lever as needed to ensure proper lubrication. This lubrication reduces friction, allowing smoother movement of the lever and preventing wear over time. The electronic nozzle 113 comprises of a gate and a magnetic coil which uses electricity from microcontroller to generate the force to control the opening/closing of gate to control the flow of the oil through a small aperture of the nozzle 113, allowing for precise control of the flow of the oil on the brake lever.

[0035]	A corrosion sensor installed within the body 101 is activated by the microcontroller to detect the presence of corrosion on the brake lever. The corrosion sensor detects rust by measuring changes in the electrical resistance of the metal surface of the break lever The sensor consists of two electrodes placed on the metal surface of the brake lever Under normal conditions, the metal has a specific resistance. As corrosion (rust) forms, the electrical resistance increases due to the non-conductive nature of rust compared to the metal surface of the leaf spring. The sensor passes a small electrical current between the electrodes, and the resistance to current flow is measured. A higher resistance indicates the presence of corrosion. The sensor continuously monitors the resistance and provides real-time data on the rust level.

[0036]	Upon detecting corrosion, the sensor sends signals to the microcontroller, which then activates a speaker 115 mounted on the body 101 to alert the user. This notification prompts the user to take necessary action for treating the detected corrosion. The speaker 115 works by converting the electrical signal into the audio signal. The speaker 115 consists of a cone known as a diaphragm attached to a coil-shaped wire placed between two magnets. When the electric signal is passed through the voice coil, a varying magnetic field is generated by the coil that interacts with the magnet causing the diaphragm to move back and forth. The movement of the diaphragm pushes and pulls air creating sound waves just like the electrical signal received and used to notify the user.

[0037]	Moreover, a battery is associated with the device to supply power to electrically powered components which are employed herein. The battery is comprised of a pair of electrodes known as a cathode and an anode. A voltage is generated between the anode and cathode via oxidation/reduction and thus produces the electrical energy to provide to the device.

[0038]	The present invention, works best in the following manner, where the hollow cuboidal body 101 is positioned on the front brake lever of the two-wheeler vehicle for stability. The body 101 is secured using L-shaped rods 102 with suction cups 103 adhering to the vehicle's dashboard. Activation of the device occurs through the push button installed on the dashboard, closing the circuit to initiate the device's operation. The artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 104 integrated with the processor captures multiple images of the brake lever, processing them into digital pulses. The ultrasonic sensor positioned within the body 101 works in synchronization with the imaging unit 104 to determine brake lever alignment. The cylindrical unit 105 mounted on the ceiling portion of the body 101 houses an extendable link 106 controlled through the pneumatic arrangement 112, positioning the link 106 between the brake lever and the accelerator. The vertical telescopically operated pole 107 integrated with multiple hinges 108 extends through the pneumatic arrangement 112, positioning the clipper 109 near the brake lever for the secure grip. The motorized ball and socket joint 110 provides controlled movement to the clipper 109, effectively pulling the brake lever inward. The expandable pulley 111 arrangement 112 within the cylindrical unit 105 modifies its diameter for optimal force application. The pressure sensor on the clipper 109 detects applied pressure, adjusting the pulley 111 arrangement 112 accordingly. The two-axis lead screw arrangement 112 adjusts spacing between the accelerator and brake lever by translating the cylindrical unit 105. The electronically controlled nozzle 113 attached to the storage chamber 114 dispenses lubrication oil onto the brake lever for smooth movement. The corrosion sensor detects rust, activating the speaker 115 to notify the user for necessary treatment.

[0039]	 Although the field of the invention has been described herein with limited reference to specific embodiments, this description is not meant to be construed in a limiting sense. Various modifications of the disclosed embodiments, as well as alternate embodiments of the invention, will become apparent to persons skilled in the art upon reference to the description of the invention.  ,

title: ERGONOMIC RESTING DEVICE
abstract: A ergonomic resting device, comprising an L-shaped frame 101 having a first section 102 and second section 103 positioned on a fixed surface to attain a seating posture, a tripod like structure 105 attached with lower end of link 104 to provide stability to frame 101 on surface, multiple wheels 106 attached with structure 105 to move the frame 101 on surface, a head rest 107 installed on first section 102 by means of an extendable rod 108, for providing support to the user’s head while seating on the frame 101, a pair of hand rests 109 arranged on each side of the second section 103, each by means of an extendable bar 110 for allowing the user to place arms, multiple slits 111 carved on the first section 102 and each configured with a massaging roller, to provide back and forth motion to the rollers 112.
specification:
FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001]	The present invention relates to an ergonomic resting device that provides a customizable and comfortable seating/ resting means to a user that dynamically adjust the inclination angle of the resting support and delivers targeted massage to the users back by automatically detecting the swelling on the user’s back and avoid massaging over the swelled portion.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
	
[0002]	 As modern lifestyles and work environments demand long hours of sitting or remaining in static postures, there has been growing recognition of the need for enhanced comfort and support. Prolonged sitting, especially in improper or unsupportive positions, can contribute to discomfort, muscle fatigue, and strain on the body. This has led to an increased focus on creating solutions that promote healthier sitting habits, reduce physical stress, and encourage better alignment during extended periods of rest or work. People are increasingly seeking tools that can support the body in a way that minimizes strain and enhances overall comfort. The challenge lies in developing a solution that adapts to various body types and activities, providing customized support that fosters better posture, relaxation, and long-term well-being. As the demand for such solutions grows, innovation in this area continues to evolve, with an emphasis on improving user experience while promoting physical health.

[0003]	 Traditional methods of providing support during prolonged sitting or resting often include basic chairs, cushions, or adjustable supports. These solutions typically offer limited customization and may not effectively address individual body types or postures. Cushions or basic backrests may provide some comfort, but they often lack the ability to maintain optimal alignment or evenly distribute weight, leading to discomfort after extended use. Additionally, many traditional options are bulky or difficult to adjust, limiting their adaptability to various sitting positions or activities. While these methods may offer temporary relief, they fail to provide continuous support that promotes long-term well-being, often resulting in discomfort or increased strain after prolonged use.

[0004]	US6065808A discloses about an adjustable and portable massage chair. The massage chair includes a seat subassembly and an upper body support subassembly. The seat subassembly is comprised of a pair of front legs and a pair of rear legs, the rear legs being pivotally attached to the front legs. A seat is pivotally attached to the upper end of the pair of front legs and adjustably attached to the upper end of a seat support post. The lower end of the seat support post is pivotally attached to a lower portion of the rear legs. The upper body subassembly is comprised of a pair of support legs pivotally attached at their lower portion to a lower portion of the front legs of the seat subassembly. A chest support is pivotally attached to the upper portion of the support legs, and a face cradle is pivotally attached to the chest support. An arm support is located below the chest support and pivotally attached to a mid-portion of the support legs. A pair of connector arms extend between the support legs of the upper body support subassembly and the front legs of the seat subassembly. The connector arms are slidingly attached to the support legs and pivotally attached to the front legs to thereby permit the seat subassembly and the upper body support subassembly to be folded towards each other.

[0005]	US7909406B2 discloses about an invention a resting apparatus which is secured by a user's seat and provides frontal resting support during use includes a resting platform sufficient to support the leaning weight of the user and a configuration of straps to provide support in a limited or enclosed space. In various embodiment, the apparatus contains a detachable chair strap that is secured to a chair and provides stability to the apparatus in use by a Velcro connection to the enveloping components of the suspension strap. The apparatus may also be configured to allow a user to slid ably move the suspension strap to position the resting platform at a comfortable position and angle relative to the upper body of the user.
	
[0006]	Conventionally, many devices are disclosed in prior art that assist in resting. However, these existing devices often lack in providing targeted massage therapy to the user's back while sitting, resulting in discomfort or ineffective pressure distribution over extended use.

[0007]	In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that is capable of providing adjustable and supportive seating allowing users to achieve enhanced comfort and relaxation during prolonged sitting while also delivering targeted massage therapy to the back through controlled and adjustable massaging features helping to alleviate muscle tension and promote improved blood circulation.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0008]	 The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0009]	 An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of providing an adjustable and supportive seating means to a user, thereby enabling users to achieve enhanced comfort and relaxation during prolonged periods of sitting.

[0010]	Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of delivering targeted massage therapy to the user's back while sitting, through controlled and adjustable massaging means, thereby alleviating muscle tension and promoting improved blood circulation.

[0011]	 Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of continuously monitoring the user's weight distribution and the stability of the seating means, and accordingly provides real-time alerts if imbalances or potential safety issues are detected.
 	
[0012]	 The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0013]	 The present invention relates to an ergonomic resting device that provides a customizable resting means to a user that allows the user to adjust height of head support and the hand resting means as per the user’s preference and allows the user to adjust inclination angle of the back support as per said user’s preference.

[0014]	 According to an embodiment of the present invention, an ergonomic resting device comprises of an L-shaped frame having a first section and second section, positioned on a fixed surface, to attain a seating posture, the second section configured with a vertical link for providing support to the frame, a tripod like structure attached with lower end of the link, to provide stability to frame on the surface, multiple wheels attached with the structure to allow movement of the frame on the surface, a head rest installed on the first section by means of an extendable rod, for providing support to the user’s head while seating on the frame, wherein a user-interface installed in a computing unit wirelessly associated with the device, to provide input command for adjusting height of the frame and head rest, an inbuilt microcontroller in response to the commands, actuates the link and rod to extend/retract as per command given, for adjusting height of frame and headrest, as per the user preference, to allow the user to rest comfortably, a pair of hand rests arranged on each side of the second section, each by means of an extendable bar for allowing the user to place arms and in case user via the computing unit provides command to adjust height of the hand rests to extend/retract to adjust height of the hand rests as per the user’s preference, multiple slits carved on the first section and each configured with a massaging roller, a pair of motorized sliders configured between each rollers and longitudinal sides of the slits to provide back and forth motion to the rollers for rolling the rollers in contact with the user’s back, for providing massaging.

[0015]	According to another embodiment of the present invention, the proposed device further comprises of an infrared sensor installed on the first section to detect swelling on the user’s back, to prevent discomfort, a cushion padding configured with second section, to provide comfort to the user while sitting, the user via the computing unit provide command to provide massage on specific area of back, for massaging the specified area, a motorized hinge configured between the first and second section, to provide angular movement to the first section to adjust angle of the first section as per the user’s preference, plurality of nodes configured with each the rollers, to provide a more textured, stimulating massage, potentially improving circulation and relieving muscle tension, a weight sensor is installed on the second section to monitor weight of the user and in case detected to be exceeding a threshold limit, a speaker installed on the frame to generate audible instruction to notify the user regarding overweight, a gyroscope is installed on the frame to detect misbalancing condition of the frame and in case of detection of misbalancing and a battery is associated with the device for supplying power to electrical and electronically operated components associated with the device.

[0016]	 While the invention has been described and shown with particular reference to the preferred embodiment, it will be apparent that variations might be possible that would fall within the scope of the present invention.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS 

[0017]	 These and other features, aspects, and advantages of the present invention will become better understood with regard to the following description, appended claims, and accompanying drawings where:
Figure 1 illustrates an isometric view of an ergonomic resting device. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE INVENTION 

[0018]	 The following description includes the preferred best mode of one embodiment of the present invention. It will be clear from this description of the invention that the invention is not limited to these illustrated embodiments but that the invention also includes a variety of modifications and embodiments thereto. Therefore, the present description should be seen as illustrative and not limiting. While the invention is susceptible to various modifications and alternative constructions, it should be understood, that there is no intention to limit the invention to the specific form disclosed, but, on the contrary, the invention is to cover all modifications, alternative constructions, and equivalents falling within the spirit and scope of the invention as defined in the claims.

[0019]	 In any embodiment described herein, the open-ended terms "comprising," "comprises,” and the like (which are synonymous with "including," "having” and "characterized by") may be replaced by the respective partially closed phrases "consisting essentially of," consists essentially of," and the like or the respective closed phrases "consisting of," "consists of, the like.

[0020]	 As used herein, the singular forms “a,” “an,” and “the” designate both the singular and the plural, unless expressly stated to designate the singular only. 	

[0021]	The present invention relates to an ergonomic resting device that is capable of providing an adjustable and customizable resting means to a user that automatically adjust the inclination of the back support of the device and the height of the hand rest as per the user requirements. Additionally, the proposed device is capable of delivering targeted massage therapy to the user’s back as per the user requirements. 

[0022]	 Referring to Figure 1, an isometric view of an ergonomic resting device is illustrated, comprising an L-shaped frame 101 having a first section 102 and a second section 103, a vertical link 104 configured with the second section 103, a tripod like structure 105 attached with lower end of the link 104, plurality of wheels 106 attached with the structure 105, a head rest 107 installed on the first section 102 by means of an extendable rod 108, a pair of hand rests 109 arranged on each side of the second section 103 by means of extendable bars 110, plurality of slits 111 carved on the first section 102 and each configured with a massaging rollers 112, a pair of motorized sliders 113 configured between each rollers 112 and longitudinal sides of the slits 111, a motorized hinge 114 configured between the first and second section 103, and a speaker 115 installed on the frame 101.

[0023]	 The device disclosed herein comprises of an L-shaped frame 101 developed to be positioned on a fixed surface. The frame 101 serves as the main structure 105 and is made from strong and lightweight materials which includes but not limited to hardened steel, aluminum alloy, hard fiber, and composite materials. The outer surface of the frame 101 is layered with a silicone member to provide comfortable experience to a user. The frame 101 comprises of two distinct sections, a first section 102 and a second section 103, respectively. The first section 102 is developed to provide support to the back portion of a user and the second section 103 is developed to allow the user to attain a seating posture. A cushion padding is configured with the second section 103 to provide comfort to the user while sitting.

[0024]	 The frame 101 is positioned on the fixed surface by means of a vertical link 104 installed underneath the second section 103. A tripod like structure 105 is attached with the lower end of the link 104 to provide stability to the frame 101 on the surface. Multiple wheels 106 are attached with the structure 105 to allow movement of the frame 101 on the surface as per the user requirement. A head rest 107 is installed on the first section 102 by means of an extendable rod 108, for providing support to the user’s head while seating on the frame 101.

[0025]	 Upon sitting over the frame 101, the user is required to access a user-interface installed in a computing unit (such as a smartphone, tablet, or other handheld devices) wirelessly linked with an inbuilt microcontroller associated with the device to give input command for adjusting height of the frame 101 and head rest 107. The computing unit is wirelessly associated with the microcontroller via a communication module which includes, but not limited to Wi-Fi (Wireless Fidelity) module, Bluetooth module, GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) module.

[0026]	 The communication module allows the microcontroller to send and receive data to and from the computing unit without the need for physical connections. The Wi-Fi module provides connectivity over local networks, enabling real-time communication over longer distances. The Bluetooth module offers short-range, low-power communication, ideal for close proximity. The GSM module allows for communication over mobile networks, facilitating remote monitoring and control from virtually anywhere. This versatile connectivity ensures seamless interaction between the microcontroller and the computing unit for enabling the user to remotely give input command for adjusting height of the frame 101 and head rest 107.

[0027]	 The microcontroller processes the input details and accordingly actuates the link 104 and the rod 108 to extend/retract as per command given, for adjusting height of frame 101 and headrest, as per the user preference. The extension/ retraction of the link 104 and the rod 108 is powered by a pneumatic unit associated with device, that includes an air compressor, air cylinder, air valves and piston which works in collaboration to aid in extension and retraction of the link 104 and the rod 108.

[0028]	 The air compressor used herein extract the air from surrounding and increases the pressure of the air by reducing the volume of the air. The air compressor is consisting of two main parts including a motor and a pump. The motor powers the compressor pump which uses the energy from the motor drive to draw in atmospheric air and compress to elevated pressure. The compressed air is then sent through a discharge tube into the cylinder across the valve. The compressed air in the cylinder tends to pushes out the piston to extend. The piston is attached to the link 104 and the rod 108, wherein the extension/retraction of the piston corresponds to the extension and retraction of the link 104 and the rod 108 as per the user preference, to allow the user to rest comfortably.

[0029]	A pair of hand rests 109 is arranged on each side of the second section 103, each by means of an extendable bar 110, for allowing the user to place arms. In case the user via the computing unit provides command to adjust height of the hand rests 109, the microcontroller actuates the bars 110 to extend/retract to adjust height of the hand rests 109 as per the user’s preference. The extension/retraction of the bars 110 is powered by the pneumatic unit associated with the device in the same manner as described above.

[0030]	 In case the user via the computing unit provides command for angular adjustment of the first section 102 with respect to the second section 103, the microcontroller actuates a motorized hinge 114 configured between the first and second section 103, to provide angular movement to the first section 102 to adjust angle of the first section 102 as per the user’s preference. The motorized hinge 114 integrates an electric motor with a traditional hinge mechanism to enable controlled, automated tilting movement of the first section 102 around a fixed axis.

[0031]	 The hinges comprise of a pair of leaf that are screwed with the surface of the first and second section 103. The leafs are connected with each other by means of a cylindrical member integrated with a shaft coupled with a DC (Direct Current) motor to provide required movement to the hinge. The rotation of the shaft in clockwise and anti-clockwise direction provides required tilting movement to the first section 102 for providing angular movement to the first section 102 to adjust the orientation of the first section 102 with respect to the second section 103 as per the user’s preference.

[0032]	Multiple slits 111 are carved on the first section 102 and each configured with a massaging roller 112. While sitting over the frame 101, in case the user via the computing unit provides command for massaging back portion, the microcontroller actuates a pair of motorized sliders 113 configured between each rollers 112 and longitudinal sides of the slits 111 to provide back and forth motion to the rollers 112 for rolling the rollers 112 in contact with the user’s back, for providing massaging to the user back.

[0033]	The motorized slider used herein consists of a sliding-rail and multiple rolling members which are integrated with a step motor. On actuation, the step motor rotates the rolling members in order to provide rolling motion to the members which results in sliding of the members for providing back and forth motion to the rollers 112 along the slider, in contact with the user’s back, for providing massaging to the user back by means of multiple nodes configured with each of the rollers 112, to provide a more textured, stimulating massage to improve circulation and relieving muscle tension.

[0034]	 Simultaneously, an infrared sensor installed on the first section 102, detect swelling on the user’s back. The infrared sensor consists of an IR (infrared) emitter and an IR (infrared) receiver. The emitter emits infrared light on the user’s back that are bounced back from the users back and returns to the receiver. The sensor then sends an electrical signal to the microcontroller for processing.
 
[0035]	 The microcontroller processes the signal received from the infrared sensor to detect swelling on the user’s back and in case of detection of the swelling, the microcontroller directs the sliders 113 aligned with a portion of back detected with swelling, to stop rolling of the rollers 112, to prevent discomfort. Further, the microcontroller regulates functionality of the sliders 113 in accordance to the age specified by the user via the computing unit, by regulating the speed of rolling of rollers 112, to prevent chance of discomfort to the user.

[0036]	 In case the user via the computing unit provide command for massage on specific area of back, then the microcontroller only actuates sliders 113 of corresponding slit, for massaging the specified area. While the user is sitting over the frame 101, a weight sensor installed on the second section 103 monitor weight of the user. The weight sensor used herein is a particular kind of transducer, more especially a weight transducer, which transform a mechanical force that is applied as an input, by the weight of the user, into a change in electrical resistance, which varies proportionally to the force being applied to the sensor. This change in electrical resistance is detected by the microcontroller linked with the sensor, in the form of an electrical signal.

[0037]	The microcontroller processes the received signals from the weight sensors in order to monitor weight of the user and in case the detected weight exceeds a threshold limit, the microcontroller activates a speaker 115 installed on the frame 101 to generate audible instruction to notify the user regarding overweight. The speaker 115 used herein is capable of producing clear and natural sound and is capable of adjusting its volume based on ambient noise levels.

[0038]	The speaker 115 consists of audio information, which is in the form of recorded voice, synthesized voice, or other sounds, generated or stored as digital data. The digital audio data is converted into analog electrical signals. Further the analog signal is amplified by an amplifier and the amplified electrical audio signal is then sent to a diaphragm, which is typically made of a lightweight and rigid material like paper, plastic, or metal, and is designed to vibrate or move back and forth when electrical signals are fed to it. This movement creates pressure variations in the surrounding air, generating sound waves in order to generate the audible sound for notifying the user regarding overweight.

[0039]	Simultaneously, a gyroscope installed on the frame 101 to detect misbalancing condition of the frame 101. The gyroscope consists of a spinning rotor that maintains its axis of rotation regardless of the orientation of the frame 101. When the frame 101 tilts, the gyroscope rotor tends to resist this change due to its angular momentum. The resistance to changes in orientation allows the gyroscope to detect the shifting of the frame 101 with respect to the surface. By measuring the forces applied as the rotor resists the changes in orientation, the gyroscope determines the misbalancing condition of the frame 101 and in case of detection of misbalancing, the microcontroller actuates the speaker 115 to notify the user, to maintain a correct siting posture.

[0040]	Lastly, a battery is installed within the device which is connected to the microcontroller that supplies current to all the electrically powered components that needs an amount of electric power to perform their functions and operation in an efficient manner. The battery utilized here, is generally a dry battery which is made up of Lithium-ion material that gives the device a long-lasting as well as an efficient DC (Direct Current) current which helps every component to function properly in an efficient manner. As the device is battery operated and do not need any electrical voltage for functioning. Hence the presence of battery leads to the portability of the device i.e., user is able to place as well as moves the device from one place to another as per the requirements.

[0041]	The present invention works best in the following manner where the L-shaped frame 101 having the first section 102 and second section 103 is positioned on the fixed surface to allow the user to attain the seating posture. The cushion padding configured with second section 103 to provide comfort to the user while sitting. The second section 103 is configured with the vertical link 104 for providing support to the frame 101. The tripod like structure 105 attached with lower end of the link 104 to provide stability to frame 101 on the surface. Multiple wheels 106 attached with the structure 105 to allow movement of the frame 101 on the surface. Further, the head rest 107 is installed on the first section 102 by means of the extendable rod 108 for providing support to the user’s head while seating on the frame 101. The user access the user-interface installed in the computing unit to provide input command for adjusting height of the frame 101 and head rest 107. Accordingly, the link 104 and rod 108 extend/retract for adjusting height of frame 101 and headrest to allow the user to rest comfortably. The pair of hand rests 109 allowing the user to place arms and in case user provides command to adjust height of the hand rests 109. The bars 110 extend/retract to adjust height of the hand rests 109 as per the user’s preference. Multiple slits 111 carved on the first section 102 and each configured with the massaging roller 112. In case while sitting the user provides command for massaging back portion. The pair of motorized sliders 113 provide back and forth motion to the rollers 112 for rolling the rollers 112 in contact with the user’s back for providing massaging.
