title: LADDER BRACKET OF A SECTION OF A TOWER OF A WIND TURBINE AND METHOD OF ASSEMBLY OF A WIND TURBINE
abstract: The object of the invention relates to a ladder bracket of a section of a tower of a wind turbine, to a set comprising a segment of a section of a tower of a wind turbine, at least one ladder bracket and a ladder section configured to be attached to a second part of the at least one ladder bracket, and also relates to a method of assembly of a wind turbine.
specification:
DESCRIPTION
OBJECT OF THE INVENTION
5 The object of the invention relates to a ladder bracket of a section of a tower
of a wind turbine, to a set comprising a segment of a section of a tower of a wind
turbine, at least one ladder bracket and a ladder section configured to be attached to a
second part of the at least one ladder bracket.
The invention also relates to a method of assembly of a wind turbine.
10
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
The wind turbines comprise a tower, a nacelle which houses the electrical
generator and a rotor formed in turn by at least two blades. The tower of the wind
turbine supports the nacelle and the rotor. Large wind turbines have steel, lattice,
15 or reinforced concrete towers or even mixed-type towers, the latter comprising
sections of different materials, for example, a lower section of concrete and an
upper section of steel or lattice.
Due to the height of the wind turbines, the tower has to be divided into
several annular sections which are stacked during the wind turbine assembly stage
20 thus forming the full height of the tower. Dividing the tower into sections has the
advantage that each section has a size such that its transport by road or rail is
easier.
One of the most commonly used materials for large towers is concrete,
since it involves competitive costs and performance compared to those for the
25 production of steel towers of similar characteristics. However, the weight of each
concrete tower section can easily exceed one hundred tons, this fact being
infrequent for metal tower sections, so stacking the concrete sections requires
heavy-tonnage lifting and positioning means. The cost of using such lifting and
positioning means, which may be for example a crane, is directly related to the
30 tonnage and height that it is capable of handling and the time of use thereof. This
3
high-tonnage crane is also used for lifting and positioning the nacelle, as the
weight of the nacelle may also exceed 100 tons.
The design of wind turbine components and the design of the connections
between them once placed, should take into account the loads they will have to
5 bear throughout their useful life to ensure the proper functioning thereof. In
particular, the connections between different concrete sections of the tower or
between an upper concrete section and an adapter disposed above the upper
concrete section for the transition between the concrete sections and the steel
sections in the case of hybrid towers or for the transition between the concrete
10 sections and the nacelle of the wind turbine in the case of full concrete towers, are
adapted to withstand the loads they will have to bear throughout their useful life,
such as gravitational loads, assembly loads, inertial loads, aerodynamic loads,
operational loads and other loads that depend on the location where the wind
turbine is to be installed, such as earthquakes.
15 The tower generally includes an interior ladder along the height of the
tower for assembling an elevator that can be displaced along the tower.
However, the above-cited loads may lead to:
- variations in the length of the sections associated with the compression of
the tower, causing deformations in the ladder, which is a problem for the elevator;
20 - deformations of the ladder in the form of bellies, making necessary to
carry out readjustments/maintenance are necessary between the ladder which
comprises a constant length, and the tower which can vary its length, mainly
under compression, at the end of assembly and over time.
The present invention solves the problems described above by providing a
25 concrete segment of an upper section of a wind turbine tower which minimizes the
undesirable local effects in the connection area between the upper concrete section
and the adapter.
4
DESCRIPTION OF THE INVENTION
The invention relates to a ladder bracket of a section of a tower of a wind
turbine comprising a ladder which in turn comprises a ladder section, wherein the
5 tower section comprises at least one segment which in turn comprises an inner wall,
and wherein the ladder bracket comprises:
- a first part configured to be attached, in use, to the inner wall of the at least one
segment of the tower section; and
- a second part configured to be connected to the first part, wherein, in use, the
10 ladder section is configured to be attached to the second part, so establishing a
connection between the first part and the second part;
wherein the connection between the first part and the second part is a sliding
connection allowing a relative position between the first part and the second part to
be modified.
15 In this way, the ladder maintains its length constant along the height of the
tower and transmits all the weight to the ground, since there are no reactions to the
bracing of the tower, or they are minimal.
Optionally, the relative position between the first part and the second part is
allowed to be modified along a longitudinal direction of the ladder.
20 Furthermore, no readjustments/maintenance are necessary between the
ladder which comprises a constant length, and the tower which can vary its length,
mainly under compression, at the end of assembly and over time.
The variations in the relative positions between the first part and the
second part of the ladder bracket may occur during the erection of the tower, in
25 particular, in a hybrid or concrete tower, after the erection of the individual tower
sections and/or after the post-tensioning of the concrete sections, for example.
Optionally, the ladder bracket further comprises:
- a pressure plate;
5
- a sliding piece disposed between the pressure plate and the second part, and
between the pressure plate and the first part;
wherein the sliding piece is configured to be in contact with the pressure plate, the
first part and the second part; and
5 - tightening means configured to tight the pressure plate against the sliding piece and
the first part, in consequence, attaching the second part to the first part.
In this way, if the external forces are below a first threshold, the relative
position between the first part and the second part does not change since the
tightening means ensure sufficient frictional force so that there is no relative
10 displacement in a longitudinal direction.
Optionally, the sliding piece is configured to be slidable, in use, with respect
to the first part and/or the second part. When the first part is attached to the sliding
piece, both of them, the first part and the sliding piece are configured to be
slidable, in use, with respect to the second part. In this way, the second part
15 attached to the ladder section maintains its fixed position and the ladder bracket of
the present invention is self-adjustable and absorbs the compression of the tower
during the different stages of assembly, so avoiding deformations in the form of
bellies.
Optionally, the sliding piece comprises a central portion configured to be in
20 contact with the first part and the pressure plate, and at least one lateral portion
configured to be in contact with the second part and the pressure plate.
Optionally, the sliding piece comprises two lateral portions configured to be
in contact with the second part and the pressure plate.
Optionally, the second part comprises two vertical profiles, wherein the
25 sliding piece is configured to be slidable, in use, with respect to the two vertical
profiles of the second part.
Optionally, the second part comprises two arms configured to support the
ladder section.
6
Optionally, the second part comprises first fixation means configured to fix
the ladder section to the two arms.
Optionally, the two arms are fixed to the two vertical profiles.
Optionally, the first part comprises an omega profile. Preferably, the omega
5 profile comprises a central portion configured to be in contact with the sliding piece
and at least one lateral portion configured to be attached, in use, to the inner wall of
the at least one segment of the tower section.
Optionally, the ladder bracket further comprises at least one wedge
configured to be disposed between the first part and the sliding piece.
10 Optionally, the at least one wedge is configured to be disposed between the
omega profile of the first part and the sliding piece.
This allows to align the ladder section with regard to the vertical direction
since inner wall in case the segment is frustoconical.
Optionally, the ladder bracket further comprises second fixation means
15 configured to fix, in use, the first part to the inner wall of the at least one segment of
the tower section.
Optionally, the sliding piece is made of a thermoplastic polymer, preferably
polypropylene or polyethylene.
The invention also related to a set comprising a segment of a section of a
20 tower of a wind turbine, at least one ladder bracket of any of preceding claims and a
ladder section configured to be attached to the second part of the at least one ladder
bracket.
This set so configured allows to regulate the ladder section along the
ladder brackets in a uniformly or an independent way.
25 Optionally, the section is a steel section or a concrete section, being part of a
steel-concrete tower or a full steel tower for the first case, or a steel-concrete tower
or a full concrete tower for the second case, respectively.
Preferably, the set comprises at least two ladder brackets, wherein the
segment comprises a height, and wherein the at least two ladder brackets are
7
disposed along the height of the segment. Optionally, the first part of the at least two
ladder brackets is different for at least one of the at least two ladder brackets.
The invention also relates to a wind turbine comprising a tower which in turn
comprises at least a section comprising at least a set as described above.
5 Optionally, the tower is a full concrete tower or a concrete-steel tower.
In this way, due to the fact that the deformations in the concrete section vary
the position of the steel sections, the ladder bracket of the present invention is also
applicable to section wherein deformations are not expected.
The invention also relates a method of assembling a wind turbine comprising
10 a tower which in turn comprises a section which in turn comprises a segment which
in turn comprises an inner wall, and a ladder comprising at least a ladder section,
wherein the method comprises a step of attaching the ladder section to the inner wall
of the segment by means of the ladder bracket described above, which in turn
comprises the following steps:
15 - a step of attaching the first part to the inner wall of the at least one segment of the
tower section; and
- a step of connecting the second part to the first part,
- a step of attaching the ladder section to the second part,
wherein the step of connecting the second part to the first part is carried out by
20 means of a sliding connection that allows a relative position between the first part
and the second part to be modified.
Optionally, the method, when it is carried out by means of the ladder bracket
comprising:
- the pressure plate;
25 - the sliding piece disposed between the pressure plate and the second part, and
between the pressure plate and the first part;
wherein the sliding piece is configured to be in contact with the pressure plate, the
first part and the second part; and
8
- tightening means configured to tight the pressure plate against the sliding piece and
the first part, in consequence, attaching the second part to the first part;
comprises the following steps:
- a step of disposing the sliding piece between the pressure plate and the second part,
5 and between the pressure plate and the first part, the sliding piece making contact
with the pressure plate, the first part and the second part;
- a step of tightening the pressure plate against the sliding plate and the first part, in
consequence, attaching the second part to the first part.
10 DESCRIPTION OF THE FIGURES
 To complement the description being made and for the sake of a better
understanding of the characteristics of the invention according to a preferred
practical embodiment thereof, attached as an integral part of said description are a set
of drawings wherein, for the purpose of illustration and not limiting the scope of the

title: COMMUNICATION METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract: Disclosed in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The method comprises: transmitting first data, wherein the first data comprises M pieces of channel information feedback and N first identifiers, the N first identifiers are used for indicating N first data sets stored at a receiving end, the N first identifiers correspond to the N first data sets on a one-to-one basis, N and M are positive integers, each of the N first data sets comprises one or more pieces of ground-truth channel information, the M pieces of channel information feedback correspond to M pieces of ground-truth channel information, the N first data sets comprise the M pieces of ground-truth channel information, and each of the N first data sets comprises at least one of the M pieces of ground-truth channel information. The method can reduce data set transmission overheads.
specification:
[0001] This application claims priority to Chinese Patent Application No.
202410385900.6, filed with the China National Intellectual Property
Administration on March 30, 2024 and entitled "COMMUNICATION METHOD
5 AND APPARATUS", and Chinese Patent Application No. 202410417512.1, filed
with the China National Intellectual Property Administration on April 3, 2024 and
entitled "COMMUNICATION METHOD AND APPARATUS", which are
incorporated herein by reference in their entireties.
TECHNICAL FIELD
10 [0002] Embodiments of this application relate to the field of communication
technologies, and in particular, to a communication method and apparatus.
BACKGROUND
[0003] In an existing communication system, user equipment (user equipment,
UE) measures a channel state information reference signal (channel state
15 information reference signal, CSI-RS), a synchronization signal block
(synchronization signal/physical broadcast channel block, SSB), or the like to
obtain downlink CSI, and then the UE generates a CSI report in a manner
predefined in a protocol or configured by a base station, and feeds back the CSI to
the base station, so that the base station obtains the downlink CSI.
20 [0004] The CSI may be fed back by using a two-sided model. For example, a
terminal side device (for example, the UE) compresses and quantizes the CSI by
using an encoder (for example, a CSI generator), and a network side device (for
example, the base station) restores the CSI by using a decoder (for example, a CSI
reconstructor). The two-sided model may be implemented through joint training or
25 separate training (independent training). The joint training means that two
submodels are jointly trained on a same node or different nodes. The independent
training means that the two submodels (for example, the encoder and the decoder)
are independently trained by using a same dataset or associated datasets.
[0005] To implement independent training of the two-sided model, the network
30 side device and the terminal side device exchange a dataset including ground-truth
3
CSI and CSI feedback. Since model training usually requires a large amount of data,
the exchange of the dataset between the network side device and the terminal side
device causes large dataset transmission overheads.
SUMMARY
5 [0006] This application discloses a communication method and apparatus. The
method can reduce dataset transmission overheads between a network side device
and a terminal side device.
[0007] The following describes this application from different aspects. It should
be understood that mutual reference may be made to the following implementations
10 and beneficial effects in different aspects.
[0008] According to a first aspect, this application discloses a communication
method. The method may be performed by a network side device or a module (for
example, a chip) in the network side device, or a terminal side device or a module
(for example, a chip) in the terminal side device. The method may include:
15 transmitting first data, where the first data includes M pieces of channel information
feedback and N first identifiers, the N first identifiers indicate N first datasets stored
at a receive end, the N first identifiers are in one-to-one correspondence with the N
first datasets, N and M are positive integers, each of the N first datasets includes
one or more pieces of ground-truth channel information, the M pieces of channel
20 information feedback correspond to M pieces of ground-truth channel information,
the N first datasets include the M pieces of ground-truth channel information, and
each of the N first datasets includes at least one of the M pieces of ground-truth
channel information.
[0009] In this embodiment of this application, only channel information
25 feedback and a first identifier are transmitted between a transmit end and a receive
end, and the first identifier indicates a first dataset stored at the receive end. In this
way, the transmit end does not need to send the first dataset, and the receive end
can obtain, from the storage based on the first identifier, the first dataset
corresponding to the first identifier. It may be understood that, since a data amount
4
of the first identifier is less than a data amount of the first dataset, the method can
reduce dataset transmission overheads.
[0010] In this embodiment of this application, if the network side device is the
transmit end, the terminal side device is the receive end; in this case, the
5 transmitting the first data means that the network side device sends the first data to
the terminal side device, and correspondingly, the terminal side device receives the
first data from the network side device. If the terminal side device is the transmit
end, the network side device is the receive end; in this case, the transmitting the
first data means that the terminal side device sends the first data to the network side
10 device, and correspondingly, the network side device receives the first data from
the terminal side device.
[0011] For example, the ground-truth channel information is ground-truth CSI,
the channel information feedback is CSI feedback, and the first dataset is a groundtruth CSI dataset.
15 [0012] The network side device may be a network device or an entity
communicating with the network device, and the terminal side device may be user
equipment or an entity communicating with the user equipment.
[0013] With reference to the first aspect, in a possible implementation, N is 1,
and the M pieces of ground-truth channel information are a part of or all ground20 truth channel information in the first dataset. In the method, a correspondence
between the first dataset and the M pieces of ground-truth channel information is
not limited, and the M pieces of ground-truth channel information may correspond
to one or more first datasets, thereby improving flexibility of selecting the first
dataset.
25 [0014] With reference to the first aspect, in a possible implementation, the first
data further includes at least one of the following: a format of the channel
information feedback, an identifier of one or more second datasets to which the M
pieces of channel information feedback belong, the quantity M of pieces of channel
information feedback, or first indication information, where the first indication
5
information indicates a correspondence between ground-truth channel information
in the N first datasets and the M pieces of channel information feedback.
[0015] For example, the second dataset is a CSI feedback dataset.
[0016] With reference to the first aspect, in a possible implementation, the
5 method further includes: training a first model based on the M pieces of channel
information feedback and the M pieces of ground-truth channel information, where
the first model is an encoder or a decoder in an artificial intelligence model, the
encoder is deployed on the terminal side device, and the decoder is deployed on the
network side device.
10 [0017] In this embodiment of this application, the artificial intelligence model
is a two-sided model, and the terminal side device and the network side device may
train, by using the transmitted M pieces of channel information feedback and the M
pieces of ground-truth channel information, models deployed on respective sides.
In other words, the M pieces of channel information feedback and the M pieces of
15 ground-truth channel information are training data for training the two-sided model.
This method can reduce transmission overheads of training data of the two-sided
model.
[0018] With reference to the first aspect, in a possible implementation, the M
pieces of ground-truth channel information are predefined or obtained in advance.
20 [0019] With reference to the first aspect, in a possible implementation, the
method further includes: transmitting one of first information, second information,
or third information, where any one of the first information, the second information,
or the third information is used to determine the encoder and/or the decoder for
inference or monitoring. The first information includes the N first identifiers and
25 the second information, the second information is the identifier of the one or more
second datasets to which the M pieces of channel information feedback belong, the
third information is an identifier of a third dataset, and the third dataset is a dataset
including the N first datasets and the second dataset.
6
[0020] In this embodiment of this application, the transmit end and the receive
end may implement pairing of the two-sided model by using a dataset identifier (for
example, one of the first information, the second information, or the third
information).
5 [0021] According to a second aspect, this application discloses a
communication method. The method may be performed by a network side device

[0092] 2. Channel information feedback
[0093] In an existing long term evolution (long term evolution, LTE) or new
radio (new radio, NR) communication system, a base station obtains downlink
channel state information (channel state information, CSI), to determine one or
20 more of a resource configuration for scheduling a downlink or uplink data channel
of user equipment (user equipment, UE), a modulation and coding scheme
(modulation and coding scheme, MCS) configuration, a precoding configuration,
or the like. In a time division duplex (time division duplex, TDD) system, due to
reciprocity between an uplink channel and a downlink channel, the base station may
25 obtain uplink CSI by measuring an uplink reference signal, to infer accurate
downlink CSI, for example, use the uplink CSI as the downlink CSI. In a frequency
division duplex (frequency division duplex, FDD) system, reciprocity between an
uplink and a downlink cannot be ensured, and the downlink CSI is obtained by the
UE by measuring a downlink reference signal. For example, the UE obtains the
20
downlink CSI by measuring a CSI-RS or a synchronization signal block
(synchronization signal/physical broadcast channel block, SSB). Therefore, the UE
needs to generate a CSI report in a manner predefined in a protocol or configured
by the base station, and feed back the CSI to the base station, so that the base station
5 obtains the downlink CSI. The CSI in this application is not limited to conventional
CSI, for example, one or more of a channel quality indicator (channel quality
indication, CQI), a precoding matrix indicator (precoding matrix indicator, PMI), a
rank indicator (rank indicator, RI), or a channel state information reference signal
resource indicator (channel state information reference signal resource indicator,
10 CRI), or may be channel response information, for example, one or more of a
channel response matrix, reference signal received power (reference signal received
power, RSRP), or a signal to interference plus noise ratio (signal to interference
plus noise ratio, SINR). In this application, CSI feedback may also be referred to as
channel information feedback, a CSI report, a channel information report,
15 compressed CSI, compressed channel information, or the like.
[0094] 3. Two-sided model
[0095] The two-sided model may generally refer to a network structure
including two or more submodels, and may also be referred to as a bilateral model
20 or a collaborative model. The submodels of the bilateral model are usually deployed
on different network nodes. The two-sided model needs to be trained jointly or
trained by using a same dataset to ensure that the two-sided model can be used in a
matched manner.
[0096] 4. CSI feedback based on the two-sided model
25 [0097] CSI may be fed back by using the two-sided model.
[0098] For example, as shown in FIG. 3, an encoder (CSI generator) is deployed
on a terminal side device, a decoder (CSI reconstructor) is deployed on a network
side (for example, a base station), the terminal side device compresses and
quantizes channel information (for example, CSI) by using the CSI generator, and
21
the base station restores the CSI by using the decoder (CSI reconstructor). H in FIG.
3 represents input of the CSI generator, and the input of the CSI generator may be
referred to as input CSI, ground-truth CSI, raw CSI, or target CSI. z in FIG. 3
represents feedback from the UE to the base station, and the feedback from the UE
5 to the base station may be referred to as CSI feedback, a CSI report, compressed
CSI, or latent CSI. 𝐻෩ in FIG. 3 represents output of the CSI reconstructor, and the
output of the CSI reconstructor may be referred to as output CSI, restored CSI, or
reconstructed CSI.
[0099] In this application, the two-sided model includes an encoder (CSI
10 generator) deployed on UE and a decoder (CSI reconstructor) deployed on a
network device.
[00100] 5. Dataset transmission
[00101] The two-sided model may be implemented through joint training or
separate training (independent training). The joint training means that the two
15 submodels are jointly trained on a same node or different nodes. The independent
training means that the two submodels are independently trained by using a same
dataset or associated datasets. For example, for the two-sided model in FIG. 3, input
of the CSI generator is H, whose label is z, and input of the CSI reconstructor is z,
whose label is H. Therefore, a dataset including (H, z) may be used to train both the
20 CSI generator and the CSI reconstructor. If the CSI generator and the CSI
reconstructor are trained by using the same dataset, the CSI generator and the CSI
reconstructor can be used in a matched manner, that is, the CSI reconstructor may
restore z output by the CSI generator to 𝐻෩ sufficiently similar to H.
[00102] In this application, the independent training may be initiated by a
25 network side device, or may be initiated by a terminal side device.
[00103] For example, the network side device trains a CSI generator and a CSI
reconstructor of the network side device based on ground-truth CSI, generates CSI
feedback based on a trained CSI generator, and sends a dataset including the CSI
feedback and the corresponding ground-truth CSI to the terminal side device. The
22
terminal side device trains a CSI generator of the terminal side device based on the
received CSI feedback and corresponding ground-truth CSI.
[00104] For another example, the terminal side device trains a CSI generator and
a CSI reconstructor of the terminal side device based on ground-truth CSI, generates
5 CSI feedback based on a trained CSI generator, and sends a dataset including the
CSI feedback and the corresponding ground-truth CSI to the network side device.
The network side device trains a CSI reconstructor of the network side device based
on the received CSI feedback and corresponding ground-truth CSI.
[00105] To implement independent training of the two-sided model, the network
10 side device and the terminal side device may exchange a dataset including groundtruth CSI and CSI feedback. However, model training usually requires a large
amount of data. Therefore, the exchange of the dataset including the ground-truth
CSI and the CSI feedback between the network side device and the terminal side
device causes large dataset transmission overheads.
15 [00106] In embodiments of this application, the foregoing dataset (H, z) may be

title: NEUROSYNC-SCHIZOPHRENIA TREATMENT ADHERENCE & RELAPSE PREVENTION SYSTEM
abstract: In response to the increasing need for continuous and reliable mental-health care, particularly for schizophrenia treatment, this project introduces NeuroSync, an AI-powered Schizophrenia Treatment Adherence and Relapse Prevention System. NeuroSync is designed as a structured, caregiver-driven digital platform that ensures consistent treatment monitoring, early relapse detection, and timely medical intervention. The system operates through a centralized clinical framework involving verified caregivers and licensed psychiatrists, all governed by an administrative authority. Caregivers record daily medication adherence, sleep patterns, routine stability, and observed behavioral changes. Artificial Intelligence analyzes this real-world data to identify early warning signs of relapse and generates alerts for medical review. Psychiatrists access summarized dashboards containing adherence metrics, behavioral trends, and AI-generated risk scores, enabling proactive treatment adjustments before symptom escalation. NeuroSync eliminates the need for direct patient interaction, ensuring safety, data accuracy, and ethical use in mental-health care. By bridging the gap between caregivers and doctors through intelligent monitoring and centralized oversight, NeuroSync enhances transparency, efficiency, and long-term stability in schizophrenia management.
specification:
The invention relates to advancements in the healthcare and mental-health technology domain, specifically focusing on schizophrenia treatment monitoring and relapse prevention. It introduces an AI-assisted, caregiver-centric system that enables continuous observation, predictive risk analysis, and clinical supervision through a centralized digital platform. 
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION 
Schizophrenia is a chronic mental disorder that requires strict medication adherence, routine stability, and continuous monitoring. Traditional treatment methods rely heavily on periodic clinical visits, during which early relapse indicators—such as sleep disruption, behavioral changes, or missed medication—often go unnoticed. Existing mental-health applications focus mainly on general wellness or self-reporting, which may be unreliable during psychotic episodes.NeuroSync addresses these challenges by introducing a caregiver-driven, AI-assisted monitoring system governed by medical professionals. The platform ensures ethical practices, structured observation, and clinical oversight by allowing only authorized caregivers and licensed psychiatrists to participate. Centralized data management and AI-based analysis enable early detection of relapse risk, reducing crises and hospitalization. 
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION 
NeuroSync is an AI-powered schizophrenia treatment monitoring system that connects caregivers and psychiatrists through a centralized platform. It ensures treatment adherence, predicts early relapse risk, and supports timely medical intervention, thereby improving patient stability and long-term outcomes. 

 Centralized & Secure Platform • NeuroSync operates on a centralized system managed by an administrative authority, ensuring secure access, transparency, and ethical compliance. • Authorized Caregiver—Doctor Workflow • Only verified caregivers and licensed psychiatrists can access the platform, ensuring reliable data entry and clinical oversight. • AI-Based Relapse Risk Analysis • Artificial Intelligence analyzes caregiver-reported medication adherence, sleep, routine, and. behavioral data to detect early relapse risk. • Clinical Dashboards & Alerts • Doctors receive summarized dashboards, adherence trends, and real-time alerts to support timely and informed treatment decisions. • Scalable & Efficient Design • The system is scalable, privacy-focused, and designed to reduce delays, improve coordination, and enhance long-term schizophrenia treatment outcomes


NeuroSync is a centralized AI-based web and mobile system designed to support schizophrenia treatment through continuous caregiver monitoring and doctor supervision. The platform ensures secure data handling, real-time analysis, and structured communication between caregivers and psychiatrists. Caregivers log daily treatment-related observations, which are processed by Al algorithms to identify early warning signs of relapse. Psychiatrists access this information through clinical dashboards, enabling proactive treatment management. The system maintains high standards of data integrity, scalability, and operational efficiency, contributing to improved mental-health outcomes. 


Claim I : NeuroSync provides a caregiver-driven, AI-assisted system for monitoring schizophrenia treatment adherence and detecting early relapse risk. 2. Claim2 : The system connects caregivers and psychiatrists through a centralized platform, ensuring secure data access and clinical oversight. 3. Claim3 : AI-based pattern analysis enables early identification of relapse indicators, supporting timely medical intervention. 4. Claim4 : The platform eliminates reliance on patient self-reporting, improving data accuracy and safety. 5. Claim5 : NeuroSync enhances transparency, efficiency, and long-term stability in schizophrenia treatment management.

title: BB 8 DROID FOR KIDS
abstract:
The BB-8 Droid for Kids is a fun and engaging spherical robot that teaches youngsters the
fundamentals of robotics and programming. The robot, which draws inspiration from the wellknown
BB-8 character, has a robust 3600 rolling body and a magnetically balanced head that
maintains alignment while in motion. DC motors, sensors, and a microcontroller are used by the
internal drive system to provide responsive behavior and seamless motion control. Children can
experiment with movement, steering, and basic commands by utilizing a smartphone app or remote
control to operate the droid remotelyThe BB-8 Droid helps children learn skills like motor control,
balance stability, electronics, and coding logic in addition to being entertaining. Future
improvements, such as the addition of sensors for obstacle detection or voice interaction, are
supported by its modular design. The BB-8 Droid is a great tool for encouraging young learners'
creativity, curiosity, and early STEM abilities because it is small, safe, and easy to use. The robot is
appropriate for both novices and young enthusiasts due to its kid-friendly interface. Long hours of
uninterrupted play and study are guaranteed by its effective power system. By encouraging practical
exploration, the gadget helps kids learn how to solve problems in real time. All things considered,
the BB-8 Droid encourages kids to gain self-assurance while investigating robotics in a fun and
approachable way.
specification:
THE FIELD OF INVENTION (HEALTHCARE / MEDICAL DEVICES)
The current invention is related to interactive smart toys and educational robots. More precisely, it
deals with a kid-friendly spherical robot system that combines motion control, wireless
communication, sensor-based interaction, and fundamental programming capabilities. This
invention, which offers a learning-oriented robotic platform that fosters young users creativity,
problem-solving, and early technical skills, sits at the nexus of STEM education, kid-friendly
robotics, and consumer electronic toys.
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
Educational robotics has grown in importance as a method for teaching kids about STEM (science,
technology, engineering, and mathematics) in recent years. Interactive technologies that make
difficult concepts easier to understand are necessary because traditional teaching methods
frequently fail to engage younger students. Nevertheless, a lot of the robotic toys that are now on
the market are either excessively complicated, brittle, or devoid of kid-friendly characteristics.
Despite their popularity, the majority of BB-8-inspired toys are primarily meant for amusement and
offer little chance to learn programming or comprehend actual robotic processes. A small and robust
educational spherical robot with wireless control, entertaining movement, and learning-oriented
features is required to get around these restrictions. This need is met by the current creation, which
provides a BB-8 Droid for Kids.
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
The educational spherical robot known as the BB-8 Droid for Kids was created to make learning
engaging and enjoyable for young children. For steady and lifelike motion, it has a robust 3600
rolling body with a magnetically balanced head. Youngsters can learn basic programming and
navigation by using a smartphone app or remote control to run the Droid. All things considered, the
BB-8 Droid offers a fun and safe platform that festers early STEM abilities.

title: TENNIS BALL COLLECTING ROBOT INTEGRATED WITH ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
abstract:
The Tennis Ball Collecting Robot integrated with Artificial Intelligence is designed to automate the process of retrieving tennis balls from the court, reducing manual effort and increasing training efficiency. Using AI-based vision, the system accurately detects scattered balls and determines the most efficient path for collection. The robot features autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and a gentle intake mechanism to safely gather balls from various court surfaces. Its smart control system enhances performance by optimizing collection speed and providing real-time monitoring. 
This innovation helps players, coaches, and academies save time, improve training flow, and reduce repetitive manual work, offering a more advanced and intelligent solution compared to existing ball-
collecting methods.
specification:
THE FIELD OF INVENTION (TENNIS BALL COLLECTING ROBOT) 
The present invention relates to the field of sports automation and robotics, particularly to devices designed for automated tennis ball retrieval. It involves the application of robotic mechanisms, computer vision, and autonomous navigation technologies to efficiently collect tennis balls from the court. This invention falls within the broader domains of sports equipment innovation, intelligent service robots, and automation systems aimed at improving training efficiency and reducing manual effort in tennis facilities. 
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION 
In tennis training sessions, a large number of balls are repeatedly used, resulting in continuous scattering across the court. Collecting these balls manually is time-consuming, physically tiring, and disrupts the flow of practice for players and coaches. Traditionally, ball retrieval has been done either by hand or using basic manual collection tools, which still require human effort and are inefficient during high-intensity training sessions. With the advancement of robotics and automation, several devices have been introduced to assist in ball collection. 
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION 
The system operates intelligently by identifying the position of tennis balls, planning the optimal path, and collecting them with minimal energy usage and time. Its versatile mobility allows it to adapt to different court environments, including hard, clay, and synthetic surfaces. The robot can function continuously using a rechargeable battery system and can be monitored or controlled through a simple user interface when needa. 


The robot consists of a compact, lightweight chassis designed for mobility on tennis courts. The frame supports the ball intake mechanism, storage compartment, sensors, wheels, and onboard electronics. 
• Ball Detection System 
The robot is equipped with a vision-based detection module using cameras or sensors capable of identifying tennis balls based on color, shape, and contrast. This system guides the robot toward the balls. 
• Navigation and Control 
Autonomous navigation is enabled through microcontrollers, ultrasonic/IR sensors, and optional AT algorithms. These components allow the robot to avoid obstacles, calculate optimal routes, and move accurately across various court surfaces. • Ball Intake and Collection Mechanism 
A roller-based or suction-based intake system is installed at the front of the robot. It gently lifts and transfers tennis balls into the internal storage compartment without damaging them. 


The Tennis Ball Collecting Robot is an autonomous system designed to automate the retrieval of tennis balls from the court during training and practice sessions. The robot integrates a combination of sensing, mobility, and mechanical collection mechanisms to operate without human assistance. 
Its primary function is to detect tennis balls scattered across the court, navigate toward them, and collect them efficiently into an onboard storage compaitment. The system begins operation by scanning the court using a set of sensors or an onboard vision module capable of identifying tennis balls based on their color and shape. 


 An autonomous tennis ball collecting robot comprising a ball-detection system, navigation module, intake mechanism, and storage unit designed to automatically locate and collect tennis balls from a court without human intervention. 2. A ball-detection system that identifies tennis balls using sensors or vision technology based on shape, size, and color to enable accurate positioning and movement toward scattered balls. 3. An autonomous navigation system equipped with obstacle-detection sensors that calculates optimal movement paths, avoids collisions, and adapts to different court surfaces including hard, clay, and synthetic courts. 4. A ball-intake mechanism consisting of rollers or a rotating brush designed to gently lift tennis balls from the ground and transfer them into an onboard storage compartment without causing damage. 5. A power system using a rechargeable battery configured to supply continuous energy for movement, detection, and collection functions, enabling extended operation during practice sessions.

title: SMART WOBBLE BOARD WITH INTEGRATED PRESSURE SENSORS FOR BILATERAL WEIGHT DISTRIBUTION AND PROPRIOCEPTIVE TRAINING
abstract:
This project introduces a Smart Wobble Board designed to enhance proprioceptive training and
monitor bilateral weight distribution in real-time using integrated pressure sensors. The objective is
to provide objective, quantifiable feedback to users, physiotherapists, and trainers, thereby
accelerating rehabilitation, improving balance, and preventing injuries. The board incorporates an
array of Force-Sensitive Resistors (FSRs) or piezoresistive sensors strategically placed on the top
surface, a central microcontroller unit for data acquisition and processing, and a wireless module
for data transmission to a companion application. This innovation addresses the subjectivity and
lack of objective measurement in traditional balance training. Initial testing demonstrates high
accuracy in detecting shifts in the Center of Pressure (CoP) and weight bearing asymmetry. This
technology enables personalized training protocols, supports the tracking of recovery progress, and
provides data suitable for sports science research and clinical assessment.
specification:
THE FIELD OF INVENTION:
The present invention relates to the field of rehabilitation and athletic training devices. More
specifically, it pertains to intelligent balance boards (wobble boards) embedded with an array of
pressure sensors for real-time, objective monitoring of a user's bilateral weight distribution, balance
stability, and proprioceptive performance. This invention lies at the intersection of physiotherapy,
biomechanics, digital health, and wearable/smart training technology, aiming to improve the
efficiency and objective tracking of balance and stability training.
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
Balance and proprioception training are critical components in the rehabilitation of lower-limb
injuries, especially ankle sprains and knee ligament repairs, and for enhancing athletic performance.
Traditional wobble boards and balance training methods rely on subjective observation by the
clinician or trainer, which is often inconsistent and lacks objective data. Existing digital solutions
may be overly complex, expensive, or not sufficiently portable for everyday clinical or training use.
Without continuous, objective feedback on weight-bearing symmetry and postural sway, tracking
progress is difficult, and the risk of compensatory movement patterns persists. This device
overcomes these limitations by providing immediate, quantifiable metrics on performance and
asymmetry.
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
The invention provides a novel Smart Wobble Board designed to continuously monitor a user's
bilateral weight distribution and postural stability through an integrated array of pressure sensors.
The system includes multiple, strategically placed Force-Sensitive Resistors (FSRs) on the board's
standing surface, and an embedded microcontroller for signal conditioning, calculating the Center
of Pressure (CoP), and wireless data transmission. Users can observe real-time CoP trajectory,
weight-bearing load asymmetry, and stability metrics through a mobile or desktop dashboard. This
solution standardizes balance assessment, accelerates injury rehabilitation, and provides objective
data for physiotherapists and sports professionals.

title: DIGITAL SAND TIMER
abstract:
The Digital Sand Timer is an innovative, user-friendly wellness device designed to offer gentle time
management and relaxation support through modern digital technology. Engineered for portability
and ease of use, it features an ergonomic design and intuitive controls, providing a seamless
experience for managing routines such as meditation, study breaks, or focused work sessions
anytime, anywhere. This product aims to improve productivity and relaxation by offering adjustable
timing intervals suitable for various needs, including mindfulness, task organization, stress relief,
and sleep routines.Constructed with durable, soft-touch, and visually appealing materials, the
Digital Sand Timer guarantees long-term reliability while staying comfortable and safe for everyday
use. Its cordless, rechargeable design eliminates the hassle of wires, making it highly convenient for
travel, office, and home environments. Enhanced with features like audible alerts, auto shut-off, and
USB charging, it delivers energy efficiency and ultimate user convenience.Sporting a sleek, modern
aesthetic, this timer blends style with functionality and supports a balanced lifestyle by helping users
manage their time mindfully. By addressing common challenges such as distractions from digital
screens and inconsistent work or rest schedules, the device presents a versatile time management
solution for professionals, students, and wellness-focused individuals. The Digital Sand Timer
enhances routine, encourages relaxation, and promotes effective self-care through a smart,
therapeutic design crafted for today's fast-paced world.
specification:
PREAMBLE TO THE DESCRPTION
FIELD OF INVENTION
This invention relates to the development of a wearable wellness device for personal care,
specifically a digital sand timer designed to provide effective time management and relaxation
support. The Digital Sand Timer offers an ergonomic and portable solution that helps users manage
- focused work sessions, meditation, or breaks to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and support
overall well-being, all while maintaining safety, user comfort, and modern design aesthetics.
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
The Digital Sand Timer addresses the need for effective time management and relaxation in a fastpaced
lifestyle. Existing timers often lack portability, ergonomic design, and ease of use. Traditional
models with wires limit convenience and flexibility. This device offers a cordless, wearable solution
for managing focused work sessions and breaks. It provides adjustable timing settings to suit various
user needs. The rechargeable design enhances mobility and daily usability. It combines modern
technology with user comfort and safety. Overall, it promotes productivity and well-being through
balanced time management.
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
The Digital Sand Timer is an innovative wellness device created to help users manage time
effectively for productivity and relaxation. Its ergonomic design ensures maximum comfort and
ease of use across various activities and environments. The key features include:
• Adjustable timer settings allow users to customize sessions for focused work, meditation, or
relaxation breaks.
• Simple, reliable operation through intuitive controls makes it easy to set and monitor time
intervals.
• Durable and soft-touch materials provide a comfortable grip and enhance longevity with
everyday use.
• Safety features such as automatic shut-off and audible or visual alerts ensure the device is
safe and user-friendly.
• Modern, stylish appearance integrates well with any workspace, home, or wellness setting,
adding a touch of sophistication to daily routines.


COMPLETE SPECIFICATION
1. Material: Durable, soft-touch plastics and transparent components that mimic the smooth
flow and clarity of traditional sand timers, ensuring comfort and longevity.
2. Timing Mechanism: Advanced, adjustable digital timing system for precise countdowns,
with options for multiple timing intervals.
3. Power Supply: Operates on replaceable batteries or direct plug-in, offering reliable usage
without the need for charging or cordless operation.
4. Safety Features: Integrated system for automatic shut-off when the set time has elapsed,
along with clear audible or visual alerts for user notification.
5. Design: Ergonomic, stable base and sleek hourglass-inspired silhouette designed for easy
placement on desks, bedside tables, or meditation spaces.
6. Portability: Compact and lightweight structure for convenient use in home, office,
classroom, or travel settings.
7. Control Interface: Simple buttons or dial for selecting and starting/stopping timing
intervals, designed for intuitive user experience.
8. Maintenance: Smooth, easy-to-clean surfaces for hassle-free upkeep and long-lasting
clarity.
9. Aesthetic Options: Available in a variety of colors and finishes to suit personal taste and
match different environments.



DESCRIPTION
The Digital Sand Timer is an innovative wellness device designed to deliver effective time
management for productivity, focus, and relaxation. Crafted with durable, soft-touch materials, it
ensures comfort and reliability during frequent use. Without the need for cords or charging, users
can easily track timing intervals for meditation, work sessions, or breaks in any setting—at home,
in the office, or while traveling. Adjustable timer settings and safety features such as automatic
shut-off offer a customizable and secure experience. Its ergonomic, hourglass-inspired design fits
seamlessly on desks or bedside tables, providing clear, consistent countdowns to help users manage
tasks and routines. The sleek, modern appearance blends aesthetics with practical functionality,
catering to those who value both style and efficiency. Sturdy construction supports long-term use, while the easy-to-clean surface encourages hygiene. The Digital Sand Timer integrates reliable
technology with thoughtful design to enhance daily routines, offering a convenient, portable, and
user-friendly solution for balanced time management in today's dynamic lifestyle.


We Claim
1. Claim: Ergonomic design that provides comfortable and effective time management for
work, relaxation, and wellness routines.
2. Claim: Adjustable timer settings allow users to customize countdowns for different
activities such as focus sessions, meditation, and breaks.
3. Claim: Reliable power source using replaceable batteries or direct plug-in for convenient,
uninterrupted operation.
4. Claim: Safety features including automatic shut-off and clear alerts to ensure user
convenience and protection.
5. Claim: Visual and/or audible alerts signal the end of each timing interval, helping users
stay on track with their routines.
6. Claim: Compact and lightweight construction enables easy placement and portability for
use in different environments such as home, office, or travel.
7. Claim: Durable, soft-touch materials with an easy-to-clean surface that promote comfort
and hygiene during extended use.

title: ADJUSTABLE LAPTOP HOLDER WITH BUILT-IN CHARGING PORT AND BLUETOOTH ENABLED SPEAKERS
abstract:
With the rapid growth of digital workspaces and prolonged laptop usage, there is an increasing need
for ergonomic, portable, and multifunctional accessories. This project presents an Adjustable
Laptop Holder with Built-in Charging Port and Bluetooth Enabled Speakers, designed to enhance
user comfort, productivity, and convenience. The system integrates an adjustable mechanical
structure with embedded electronic components such as a rechargeable battery, charging module,
Bluetooth audio unit, and speakers. The adjustable angles improve posture and reduce neck and
back strain, while the built-in charging port supplies power to laptops and mobile devices. The
Bluetooth-enabled speakers eliminate the need for external audio accessories. The compact and
modular design makes the laptop holder suitable for home, office, academic, and travel use.
specification:
THE FIELD OF INVENTION
The invention relates to the field of ergonomic computer accessories and consumer electronics,
particularly to a multifunctional laptop holder that integrates mechanical adjustability, device
charging, and wireless audio output into a single portable unit.
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
Traditional laptop stands mainly focus on elevation and cooling, offering limited functionality.
Users often rely on separate chargers, external speakers, and laptop stands, leading to desk clutter
and reduced portability. Extended laptop usage without ergonomic support can result in posturerelated
health issues such as neck pain and back strain. Existing solutions that provide audio or
charging support are often bulky, expensive, or lack adjustability. Therefore, there is a need for a
compact, cost-effective, and ergonomic laptop holder that combines adjustability, charging
capability, and Bluetooth-enabled audio in a single integrated system. This invention addresses
these limitations by offering a smart, all-in-one laptop holder.
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
The Adjustable Laptop Holder with Built-in Charging Port and Bluetooth Enabled Speakers
combines mechanical adjustability with embedded electronic modules. The adjustable structure
allows users to modify height and viewing angle for improved ergonomics. A rechargeable battery
powers the built-in charging port and Bluetooth speaker system. The charging module provides
stable power output for laptops and mobile devices, while the Bluetooth audio system delivers
wireless sound output. The modular internal layout enables easy maintenance and component
replacement. This invention improves workspace efficiency, reduces accessory dependency, and
enhances user comfort.


The Adjustable Laptop Holder operates by supporting the laptop on a mechanically adjustable
platform, allowing users to set a comfortable viewing angle. The built-in battery supplies power to
the charging port and Bluetooth speaker system. When activated, the charging module delivers
regulated power to connected devices. The Bluetooth module pairs with laptops or smartphones to
stream audio through the integrated speakers. Control switches allow users to manage power and
audio functions. The integrated design reduces cable clutter while enhancing ergonomics and user
experience.
